description: This source file defines the PHP class 'ViewModifyMapping' which extends 'SugarView'. It manages the display for modifying connector mappings within the SuiteCRM administration interface, including rendering the title and the connector mapping selection interface.

classes.name: ViewModifyMapping
classes.description: A PHP class extending SugarView to facilitate the modification of connector mappings within the SuiteCRM admin module.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array of HTML links forming the module's title, with links to the administration and connectors settings pages.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, which is 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads necessary connector utilities, fetches connectors, filters enabled ones, assigns data to template variables, and displays the modify mapping template.
